title: Russian opposition leader sentenced to six years in prison
summary: Sergei Udaltsov, Putin critic affiliated with the Communist party, convicted of justifying terrorism A court in Russia on Thursday convicted a pro-war activist and critic of Vladimir Putin of justifying terrorism and sentenced him to six years in prison. Sergei Udaltsov, the leader of the Left Front movement that opposes Putin and is affiliated with the Communist party, was arrested last year. Continue reading...

title: Judge tossed plus-sized retailer's Chapter 11, liquidation likely
summary: A Chapter 11 bankruptcy filing must be submitted by individuals with full corporate authority.
